milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the cyan concrete structure and face it to demonstrate they have found it. Target is the center of the cyan concrete wall at spawn-relative offset (-7, 1, -8), with max_distance=16 (generous to allow finding from moderate distance) and facing_tolerance=60 degrees to confirm the player is actually looking at the structure.
